description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Charles Snowden signed with the Falcons on Tuesday.
items.impact: Snowden had previously been on the Commanders' practice squad. He will now add some pass-rush depth for the Falcons. Snowed recorded three sacks over 15 games for the Raiders last season.
items.title: Charles Snowden signs with Falcons

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Zane Gonzalez signed with the Dolphins on Tuesday.
items.impact: After trying out multiple kickers, Gonzalez was signed by the Dolphins to begin the week. Riley Patterson was released soon after.
items.title: Zane Gonzalez brought in by Dolphins

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Riley Patterson was released by the Dolphins on Tuesday.
items.impact: The Dolphins will make a mid-season change at kicker. Veteran Zane Gonzalez was signed on Tuesday after the team tried out multiple kickers.
items.title: Riley Patterson released by Dolphins

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Najee Harris was released by the Giants on Tuesday.
items.impact: Even with starting running back Cam Skattebo in the dog house, Harris did very little in Week 6, netting just two yards on four carries. The veteran has gained only 99 yards on 31 carries in total this season, and the Giants made the decision to release him Tuesday morning. The Giants will move forward with the familiar backfield trio of Skattebo, Tyrone Tracy Jr. and Devin Singletary.
items.title: Najee Harris cut loose by Giants

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Terry McLaurin (knee) was knocked out of Monday night's loss to the 49ers and will have an MRI on Tuesday.
items.impact: McLaurin's injury looked quite ugly and the expectation is that the Commanders star wideout will miss the rest of the season. He will undergo further testing on Tuesday to determine the full severity of the injury.
items.title: Terry McLaurin (knee) to have MRI on Tuesday

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Marquez Valdes-Scantling is expected to sign to the Steelers' practice squad.
items.impact: After being let go by the Chargers this past weekend, Valdes-Scantling will meet back up with QB Aaron Rodgers and other familiar faces in Pittsburgh. Valdes-Scantling played in five games with the Steelers last season, catching 10 passes for 80 yards and a touchdown.
items.title: Marquez Valdes-Scantling to join Steelers

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: The 49ers D/ST allowed 17 points while notching four sacks in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6's Monday night game.
items.impact: San Francisco held the Commanders to just three points in the first half before Washington's offense came to life a bit after halftime. They will look to stay hot against the Falcons on the road in Week 7.
items.title: 49ers D/ST picks up four sacks in Week 6

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Eddy Pineiro made his lone field-goal attempt while adding two extra points in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6.
items.impact: Pineiro hit a 33-yard field goal in the third quarter to give the 49ers their last points of the contest. The veteran kicker has made six of his nine field goals while adding 19 extra points this season. He will take on the Falcons in Week 7.
items.title: Eddy Pineiro makes one FG in Week 6

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: George Kittle caught five of his eight targets for 69 yards and a touchdown in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6.
items.impact: Kittle finished second on the 49ers in receiving yards and catches in the close win on Monday night. The veteran tight end scored his touchdown on an 11-yard pass from Brock Purdy early in the first quarter. Overall, Kittle has 26 catches for 337 yards and five touchdowns through six games for the 49ers. With Mike Evans (Achilles soreness) expected to be held out through the team's Week 8 bye, Kittle will be a top-five fantasy tight end option in Week 7 vs. the Falcons.
items.title: George Kittle finds the end zone in Week 6

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Jordan Watkins caught his lone target for a 22-yard gain in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6.
items.impact: Watkins was quiet in the win. The veteran receiver could see a larger role in Week 7 vs. the Falcons, with Mike Evans (Achilles soreness) not expected to play. Watkins has caught just three passes for 82 yards on the season.
items.title: Jordan Watkins goes for 22 yards in Week 6

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Brandin Cooks caught one of his two targets for 13 yards in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6.
items.impact: Cooks was quiet in the win on Monday night despite Mike Evans leaving the game right before halftime with Achilles soreness. The 49ers leaned on Christian McCaffrey and George Kittle in the passing game in Evans' absence while Cooks was held to just one catch. Cooks is worth a roster spot in deeper leagues, but he should not be in starting lineups heading into Week 7's matchup vs. the Falcons.
items.title: Brandin Cooks hauls in 13-yard pass in Week 6

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Kaelon Black carried the ball eight times for 34 yards while catching his lone target for a three-yard gain in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6's Monday night game.
items.impact: Black looked good playing behind Christian McCaffrey, averaging 4.3 yards per carry for the 49ers. The rookie remains one of the top handcuffs in fantasy heading into a Week 7 matchup vs. the Falcons.
items.title: Kaelon Black sees nine touches in MNF win

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey carried the ball 16 times for 64 yards and two touchdowns while catching nine of his 10 targets for 53 yards in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6's Monday night game. He also lost a fumble in the contest.
items.impact: McCaffrey turned in a huge performance in the close win. He scored his touchdowns on a pair of one-yard runs in the first half, while he led the 49ers in targets and receptions. With seven total touchdowns through his first six games this year, the veteran tailback will be a top-three fantasy option heading into Week 7's road matchup vs. the Falcons.
items.title: Christian McCaffrey scores two TDs in Week 6

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Brocky Purdy completed 21 of his 29 passes for 264 yads and one touchdown while adding five rushes for 28 yards in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6.
items.impact: Purdy was efficient in the win over Washington on Monday night, although the offense slowed down a bit after halftime. His lone touchdown pass went to George Kittle early in the first quarter. Purdy has been one of the top fantasy QBs this season, posting 1,460 passing yards, 14 touchdowns, and two interceptions across six games. He will be a high-end fantasy option in Week 7 vs. the Falcons.
items.title: Brock Purdy throws one TD in MNF win

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: The Commanders D/ST allowed 23 points while notching two sacks and recovering a fumble in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6's Monday night game.
items.impact: Washington's defense allowed 20 points in the first half but held the 49ers to just a field goal after halftime. They recovered a Christian McCaffrey fumble while getting sacks from Shy Tuttle and Odafe Oweh. Washington will be on bye in Week 7 before they face the Eagles in Week 8.
items.title: Commanders D/ST picks up two sacks in Week 6

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Drew Stevens made his lone field-goal attempt and added two extra points in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
items.impact: Stevens nailed a 51-yard field goal in the contest, giving him three this season from at least 50 yards out. Overall, the rookie kicker has made 10 of his 12 field-goal attempts and added 10 extra points for Washington. He will be on bye in Week 7 before a Week 8 matchup vs. the Eagles.
items.title: Drew Stevens makes 51-yard FG in Week 6

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Chig Okonkwo caught all seven of his targets for 69 yards in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
items.impact: Okonkwo led the Commanders in receiving in the close loss on Monday night. The veteran tight end has caught at least four passes while reaching at least 60 yards in two straight games. He could be in store for a larger role after his bye in Week 7, as Terry McLaurin was carted off the field on Monday vs. the 49ers with a knee injury.
items.title: Chig Okonkwo goes for seven catches, 69 yards in Week 6

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Antonio Williams caught three of his four targets for 50 yards in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
items.impact: Williams finished third on the team in receiving in the loss on Monday night. The rookie wideout has shown flashes this season but his role hasn't been large enough to be trusted as a weekly starter in fantasy. He could see more work after his bye in Week 7, after Terry McLaurin had to be carted off the field during Monday night's game against the 49ers. Williams is worth a waiver claim in most leagues this week.
items.title: Antonio Williams finishes with 50 receiving yards in Week 6

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Treylon Burks caught four of his six targets for 66 yards in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
items.impact: Burks finished second on the Commanders in receiving yards behind only Chig Okonkwo. The veteran receiver saw an expanded role after Terry McLaurin suffered a knee injury in the first half and was carted off the field. Burks will have some flex appeal in Week 8 after his Week 7 bye, assuming McLaurin can't play.
items.title: Treylon Burks goes for 66 yards in Week 6

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Stefon Diggs caught six of his seven targets for 44 yards and a touchdown in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6's Monday night game.
items.impact: Diggs set a season-high in catches for the Commanders in the close loss to San Francisco. He found the end zone for the fourth time this season on a one-yard pass from Jayden Daniels late in the third quarter. Diggs should remain a key piece of the Washington passing attack, especially after Terry McLaurin had to be carted off the field with a knee injury on Monday night. The Commanders are on bye in Week 7 before they take on the Eagles in Week 8. Diggs can be considered a solid flex option in fantasy going forward.
items.title: Stefon Diggs scores TD in Week 6

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Austin Ekeler carried the ball once for three yards and caught both of his targets for four yards in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
items.impact: Ekeler mixed in behind Rachaad White in the Washington backfield. The veteran running back should continue to see a handful of touches behind White while Jacory Croskey-Merritt is on injured reserve with a groin injury.
items.title: Austin Ekeler sees three touches in Week 6

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Rachaad White carried the ball seven times for 27 yards and caught four of his five targets for 30 yards and a touchdown in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
items.impact: White had a larger role than usual with Jacory Croskey-Merritt on injured reserve with a groin injury. White took advantage, leading the Washington backfield in touches while scoring on a nine-yard pass from Jayden Daniels in the fourth quarter. White is looking like a high-end RB3 in fantasy going forward as he heads into his bye in Week 7.
items.title: Rachaad White finds the end zone in Week 6 loss

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: Jayden Daniels completed 29 of his 40 passes for 300 yards and two touchdowns while adding four rushes for 10 yards in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
items.impact: Unlike Week 5, Daniels didn't do much damage on the ground, but he made up for it with a solid day in the passing attack. His touchdown passes both came in the second half with one going to Stefon Diggs and the other to Rachaad White. Daniels has thrown for 759 yards and five touchdowns across four games this season. A solid QB1 in fantasy going forward, he will be on bye in Week 7 before taking on the Eagles in Week 8.
items.title: Jayden Daniels throws for 300 yards, two TDs in Week 6

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said Mike Evans is dealing with Achilles soreness.
items.impact: There is no rupture, which is a positive sign after Evans left Monday's game late in the first half. He'll continue to be further evaluated later in the week.
items.title: Mike Evans dealing with Achilles soreness
